producer_report.summary:
Planning is now a real per-item pass, and the refusal gate fires on vague requests. I removed the two defaults that disabled it. Every job used to get the rung Implementation, and the first line of an unread request counted as its acceptance.

`cargo test --locked`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --all --check` all pass. I ran `cargo run --locked -q -p athena-cli -- plan` in the work copy; it printed the explicit "nothing is open" line. I did not exercise it against a populated queue; the tests cover that with a fixture.

What the pass does (`reading::plan_entry`, in `reading.rs`, deterministic code that calls no model):
- **Reads:** the request text, the job's reading if there is one, the records, and the repository's tracked files at head.
- **Acceptance:** only bullet lines of the request, or a reading's criteria.
- **Rung:** the steward proposal's, else `plan::infer_rung`, else none. `infer_rung` takes the highest rung among the files named (`BRIEF.md`, `docs/design/` and `docs/decisions.md`, `defaults.toml`, anything else is code), or failing that the kind of work in the words. It returns none for text like "make it better".
- **Touches:** a bare file name such as `plan.rs` resolves to the one tracked file of that name.
- **Open questions:** a reading's question and decline reason, a named path that is not in the repository (a deliverable that creates the file is not asked about), and a job id with no record (not made a dependency). It also says why a rung, acceptance or touched path is missing.
- **Gate:** an item missing a goal, rung or acceptance is refused. `Refusal` now carries the open questions, and `drain` reports it in `Report::refused` and does not run it.
- **Grouping:** two items naming the same path land in different groups; disjoint ones share a group.

`athena plan` and `athena plan --json` print the order, groups, each item's goal, rung, acceptance, open questions, dependencies and touches, then the flagged items with what they lack. When nothing is open it says so. When every open item is flagged it says "nothing can be worked: every open item is flagged or waits in a loop". The view comes from `drain::plan_view` and `display::plan`.

A queued request without a bullet list is now refused until it is made specific or read with `athena go`. Two existing real-steps drain tests used "Add a greeting to the README." and failed under the new gate (queue empty, nothing run). I changed their requests to a specified one.

Docs: D106 added to `docs/decisions.md`, and the D105 tradeoff text about the weak gate is rewritten. `CHANGELOG.md`, `README.md` and `docs/architecture.md` are updated. They say plainly that the pass is deterministic code with no model call, and that `plan::trace` and `GapLog` are still not wired to the records (follow-up). The changelog and D106 name `display.rs`, `main.rs` and `tests/drain.rs` as the files touched beyond `plan.rs`, `reading.rs` and `drain.rs`.

checks_run.note: Full workspace run. It exited zero; I could not read the saved output file, so I did not see the per-binary totals. Before the docs edits, `-p athena-core --lib` passed 211 tests and `-p athena-cli --test drain` passed 43.
Printed the explicit nothing-open line in the work copy.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test`: a new test shows an unread request with no bullets and no path-like words (for example 'make it better') is flagged underspecified. The flag names the missing field, and the item is not in Plan::order.
criteria_check.evidence: `reading::tests::a_vague_request_is_flagged_for_what_it_lacks_and_is_not_in_the_plan_order` checks `missing()` is [ladder rung, acceptance], `order` is empty, and the refusal carries the questions.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test`: a new test shows a request's first line is no longer copied into acceptance. Only explicit acceptance bullets, or a reading's criteria, fill it.
criteria_check.evidence: `reading::tests::only_listed_bullets_or_a_readings_criteria_are_acceptance`: a prose-only request has empty acceptance; bullets and a reading's criteria fill it.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test`: a new test shows a non-proposal job's rung is inferred from its request or reading (for example docs/design work vs code), or flagged as missing. It is never silently set to Implementation, and an item with no determinable rung is refused.
criteria_check.evidence: `reading::tests::the_rung_is_the_proposals_else_inferred_else_missing` and `plan::tests::the_rung_comes_from_the_files_named_else_the_kind_of_work_else_nothing`. A design path gives DesignDecisions, a code path gives Implementation, and a vague request gives none with `missing() == [ladder rung]`.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test`: tests assert that open_questions are filled and checked for a read and an unread request. Questions include ambiguity found by the pass, such as a touched path that does not exist in the repository and an unresolved referenced job.
criteria_check.evidence: `reading::tests::open_questions_are_found_for_an_unread_and_for_a_read_request` asserts the unknown job, the missing path, the reading's question, the decline reason and a missing Modify path. It also asserts a specified request has no questions.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test`: a test shows two open items that name the same path get a dependency or are put in different groups. Items with disjoint touches are grouped together.

Run `cargo test`: a drain test using RealSteps over a records fixture with one specified and one vague queued item shows the vague one in Report::refused with a reason, and not run as a job. The specified one runs.
criteria_check.evidence: `tests/drain.rs::a_vague_queued_request_is_refused_with_a_reason_and_never_run_while_a_specified_one_runs`. The older vague request is in `refused` with non-empty open questions and its state stays `queued`. Only the specified item produces a job and lands.

criteria_check.criterion: A user-invokable command (a new `athena plan` or equivalent, exercised with `cargo run`) prints the coordinated plan: order, parallel groups, each item's goal, rung, acceptance, open questions, dependencies and touches, and the flagged items with reasons. When nothing is open it says so explicitly instead of printing an empty success.
criteria_check.evidence: `cargo run --locked -q -p athena-cli -- plan` printed 'plan        nothing is open: no queued request and no approved job waits to be worked'. The populated output is checked by `items_are_worked_in_plan_order_not_oldest_first` (order, group, goal, rung, acceptance, depends on, touches) and by the vague-request test, which checks the flagged lines.

criteria_check.criterion: display.rs, main.rs and any other files touched outside plan.rs, reading.rs and drain.rs are named in the change's docs or decision entry. The tradeoff text in docs/decisions.md about the gate rarely firing is updated to describe the new behavior.
criteria_check.evidence: D106 and the CHANGELOG entry name `display.rs`, `main.rs`, `tests/drain.rs` and the docs. The D105 tradeoff is rewritten to say the gate rarely fired because of the defaults, which D106 removes. D106's tradeoff describes the new behavior.

criteria_check.criterion: The change stays on the rust toolchain: `cargo clippy` is clean and `cargo fmt --check` passes. It uses no new secrets or personal data.
criteria_check.evidence: Both commands ran clean. Only Rust code and docs changed, and none of the boundary-scan words appear in the added text.

criteria_check.criterion: The docs say plainly whether the planning pass is deterministic code or calls a model, and whether the plan::trace and GapLog audit is wired to the records or still follow-up.
criteria_check.evidence: README, D106, the CHANGELOG entry and docs/architecture.md each say the pass is deterministic code with no model call, and that `plan::trace` and `GapLog` are still not wired to the records (follow-up).

open_issues: The rung and touch inference is a word and path heuristic. A wrong rung only changes ordering, and no rung is a refusal. Whether the word lists in `plan::infer_rung` suit real steward requests needs a look at actual queued items.

Steward-queued requests are free text. Under the gate they stay queued as refused until the steward writes bullets or someone runs `athena go` to read them. A prompt change would be needed to have the steward emit bullets, and prompts were out of scope.
`plan::trace` and `GapLog` are still not wired to the records; this is documented as follow-up.
`athena plan` shows only queued and approved-and-read jobs. In-limit proposals not yet approved are not shown, since they have no job yet.
`cargo test --locked` exited zero for the full run, but I could not read its saved output file, so I did not see the per-binary totals.
mistakes: I first wrote the drain module-doc edit with a wrong parameter name (`new_str`). The tool accepted it and I confirmed the file content afterwards, so nothing was lost.
I did not first check whether the two real-steps drain tests, which use 'Add a greeting to the README.', would survive the new gate. They did not; I fixed them after seeing the failures.
learnings: The Bash tool here allows only cargo, git, ls, chmod, mv and rm: no pipes, tail, head or grep. Use the Grep tool for searching, and run cargo directly.
`cargo fmt --all` rewrites files and the harness then reports them as changed on disk. Re-read before editing again.
A steward request or `ask --later` request is free text with no bullets, so under the new gate such items are refused until a reading exists.
`Records.jobs` is a `BTreeMap<String, JobRecords>`; `Records::default()` and `JobRecords::default()` are usable in tests.
desires: A Bash tool that allows tail or grep, or a way to read oversized tool output saved to disk, so I could confirm per-binary test totals from the full run.
